text: Ironvale Athletic successfully executed their low block and direct, vertical passing style by intercepting the ball deep in their half and launching a swift counterattack against Redmond Rovers’ high press and high defensive line. To counter this, coaching emphasis should focus on improving defensive line coordination to better handle rapid counterattacks and maintain shape under pressure.
